messages:
maria-docs: Heads-up: created PR to patch docs after this morning's outage — adds status page link, known-issues note, and workaround for token renewals. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 Please review when you can.

sam-eng: Thanks — what's the merge window? need this live before next customer sync at 9:30PT.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build failed for PR #4823 — 1 broken link (internal: /sdk/js/old-init -> 404). Full log: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9845

maria-docs: Ack. I can fix the broken link. It should point to /sdk/js/v2-initialize. Also will add a snippet showing the rollback command. Pushing patch now.

nina-qa: Note: QA saw the workaround cause to require a hot-restart if local cache present. Added a note to the docs PR, see comment.

oliver-sre: Recommend also adding status page link to the incident timeline and include 'affected regions' bullet. Otherwise lgtm from SRE.

maria-docs: Patch pushed: updated link and added workaround note and region bullets. Also included markdown snippet:

```markdown
> Workaround: restart inference service with env var REDWOOD_RENEW_TOKENS=1

See: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-21-token-regen
```

CI rebuilding...

ci-bot: docs-preview: rebuild success. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.ai/

sam-eng: @maria-docs great — can you merge after 2pm PT? I'll coordinate with product for the customer update.

maria-docs: Yes merging at 2:05pm PT unless anyone objects. @oliver-sre @nina-qa ok?

oliver-sre: ok :thumbsup:

nina-qa: ok

maria-docs: Merged. Deploying to prod docs. Closing the PR.
